Chic little pizza eatery in Bình Thanh district
Mar 2023 • Couples
We walked here after our massage, for lunch they have six types of pizza, we ordered the 4 slices combo ( pizzas, 2 soft drink and two desert which we chose the rum gelato). The pizza came out really fast, the dough was very crunchy and light. We ordered the margarita, zucchina , funghi, and the Regina. My favorite were the margarita and the funghi. The price was awesome, less than $17, all that for the two of us. Check this place out whenever you are in district Bình Thanh.
